preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 3 <= n <= 200000 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 3 and 200,000 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines per test case (one for count, one for operations).

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[2*i]) <= n_i + 5 for i, n_i in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the number of operations m is at most n + 5.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n_i and 1 <= y <= n_i and x != y for x, y in ops) for i, (n_i, ops) in enumerate(zip(test_cases, parsed_ops)))
postconditions.description: All operation indices x and y are within [1, n] and x != y.

postconditions.expression: all(final_state_ones == n_i - 1 and final_state_twos == 1 for i, (n_i, ops) in enumerate(zip(test_cases, parsed_ops)))
postconditions.description: After applying the sequence of operations, the array contains exactly n-1 ones and 1 two.
